prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: three-frame animated remake of an existing WoW comic popup.
Input image: original single-frame popup, a style and palette reference. Turn it into a NEW three-frame horizontal sprite strip; do not overwrite the original.
Canvas: exactly THREE equal SQUARE cells in ONE horizontal row, 3:1 wide image, preferably 1536x512. GENUINE transparent background. No grid, separators, labels, numbers or extra words.
Composition: use the reference's simple bold comic identity, thick outlines, clear angular burst and sparse halftone. FLAT printed ink color shapes, no realistic flame, rocks, metal, glow or complex scenery.
Draw the specified wordmark once and duplicate it unchanged across the three cells: SAME spelling, glyphs, letter spacing, scale, tilt, center anchor and baseline. Full word visible in every frame. Animate the BURST and halftone flecks only.
Frames left to right: 01 onset = compact tight burst behind the full-size word; 02 peak = larger emphatic version of the original burst; 03 aftershock = the burst breaks into a few outward-moving colored angular pieces and sparse dots, while the word stays unchanged.
IMPORTANT SPACING: each complete word-plus-effects sticker fits inside the middle 60% width and 60% height of its square cell. Leave broad completely transparent gutters, at least 20% on all four sides of each cell. No line, fragment or shadow reaches a cell boundary. All three stickers isolated and centered.
Opaque lettering with crisp anti-aliased edges, legible at 256x256. No checkerboard painted into the art, no logos, no watermarks.
Specific appearance: Preserve WHITE bold slanted sans-serif lettering, very thick BLACK outline and short black offset shadow. Preserve a bright flat YELLOW angular starburst with a thick ORANGE outer border, sparse tiny orange halftone dots inside. Yellow/orange burst pieces in aftershock. Closely recognizable as the supplied original; same sunny punchy comic palette.
Text (verbatim, exactly ONCE per cell): "POW!". No substitutions.
